visualCharacteristics.purpose: Row of topic tag pills linking to related content
visualCharacteristics.layout: Wrapping row of small bordered pills
notable: Plain-text items render as non-interactive pills

contentPattern.structure: One cell holding the tag links as a list or as link paragraphs

usage: Use at the end of an article or press release to list its topics.
reuseGuidance: Fits short topic labels that link to filtered overviews; not for navigation menus or long link lists.
